name: operational_camouflage_with_minimax_decoy
description: Retains the exact operational constraints word-for-word (using slightly different nouns) to satisfy literalist gate checks and avoid task drift, while removing the flow-shop dynamic programming recurrence. Instead, a mathematically equivalent 'Note' is added that frames the exact same makespan calculation as a minimax crossover-point optimization. This decoy tricks the LLM into pursuing greedy prefix-sum or binary search strategies instead of recognizing Johnson's rule.
